behavior: In a single real workspace, after java_code_actions mints an actionId handle for a code action on a file, and that same file is then edited on disk (with the edit observed by the workspace, advancing its sync generation) before java_apply_code_action resolves the handle, the resolve call always errors and never returns an edit.
rationale: Only observable via a real JDT LS instance, a real disk edit and the real two-phase codeAction/resolve round-trip (spike D) -- matrix's e2e_scenario for integration shape -- reproducing this feature's own context verbatim ('mint a handle, edit the file, resolve -- must error') [INV-CA-1]. Falsifies a handle table keyed on actionId alone, or a generation captured only at mint time and never re-checked at resolve, returning the stale edit instead of erroring.
